title: Four
text: “What are you going to do, young lady?”
“I want two swords.”
“Sakura-chan fights with two swords, after all.”

In that regard, Sakura-chan’s fighting style is definitely on the unconventional side. Even in her Filolial Queen form, she wears a sword on each hip. Sakura-chan only fights alongside her Father, but according to him, she fights as if she were dancing with two swords. Apparently, this doesn’t change whether she’s in her angel form or her Filolial form. Hmm, I’d really like to see that soon.
“Well then, it’s going to cost some money to get good gear.”
“For now, we’re making do with swords we’ve stolen from bandits.”
“What about you, Keel? We could custom-order claws or fangs from monsters, but would you want to wear them?”
“I’m not a monster!”
“It’s because you’re a Beastman and lean more toward the beast side. As for human weapons… I wonder what would be good. Honestly, any light weapon will do for me.”
“Keel-kun is using a dagger for now, right?”
“Yeah! It’s shorter than Sakura-chan’s, but I’m dual-wielding!”
“An-chan. You’ve got your hands full.”
“Ahaha…”

So that means Sakura-chan and Keel are using a total of four weapons? Since we need to save money in Melromarc, the budget might be a bit tight. Since we’re at it, if they’re going to use two weapons, how about equipping Keel with claws or fangs? He’s been transforming into a puppy all the time lately, after all.
“It depends on the budget and the materials. You guys aren’t exactly taking down that many monsters, so there’s a limit to how powerful the gear can be.”
“Umm…”
Father is grumbling. But don’t worry. I’ve already given the weapon shop owner some materials.
If we ask Father, we can pretend that he—who’s actually quite skilled—made the gear himself. I’m sure he understands that. Without a word, he pulls out the blueprints.
“I’ll craft the one for the young lady from the materials. As for Keel… I’ll buy one for him, and I’ll give him another one from my own stock.”
Look, the old man just winked at me to give me a signal. I gave him a thumbs-up in response.
“Last up is An-chan and Spear An-chan’s armor.”
“I’d like to give Motoyasu-kun some good gear too, though…”
Over in Siltvelt, he’s wearing dropped armor, but right now it’s armor he stole from bandits. He’s been buying cheap accessories like gauntlets to round out his set.
“I think Father’s armor is the best choice to start with.”
“That’s right! Since An-chan and the others have plenty of Filolial-sama, if we gather their feathers and such, we can make some great gear.”
Hmm… armor made from Filolial-sama, you say? I seem to recall wearing some myself. You decorate the armor with everyone’s feathers and wear it.

It makes me feel incredibly happy. Plus, it’s so much fun to wear a headpiece with feather decorations—like a Native American headdress—and ride off in a carriage with a dashing stride. I’m sure it’s that kind of wonderful gear.
“Spear Guy. Don’t let your eyes sparkle so much it’s almost too much.”
“You’ve got the same look in your eyes as Keel-kun at mealtime.”
“Do my eyes really sparkle that much!?”
“Yeah. You look so happy that it makes me happy just making it.”
“Eh… I’m not really sparkling that much.”
Filolial-sama’s armor. It’s magnificent—as expected, this weapons shop owner is truly a master craftsman.
“Motoyasu-kun has been carefully saving Yuki-chan and the others’ shed feathers, so why not have him make one for you while we’re at it?”

Ah, come to think of it, my Father from the first world owned a costume that looked a lot like Filo-tan. I seem to recall a mysterious pig was inside it, but I really want that outfit. If I wore it, I might feel as happy as if I were wrapped up in Filo-tan herself.
I’m starting to wonder how he even got his hands on it. But there’s no way my current Father would know. If I could just get my hands on that outfit…
“Hey! Motoyasu-kun? Are you listening? No good. He’s gone off to his own world and won’t come back.”
“…As for An-chan, sure. With this material, I’ll make some ‘Barbarian Armor’ and customize it my own way.”
“Barbarian… that sounds kind of wild.”
“Sounds cool, big bro.”
“Well, yeah… I’d also like to buy armor for Keel-kun and Sakura-chan…”
“I want a chest guard, big bro.”
“Sakura says it’s too tight, so she’s good.”
“Really? Got it. Elena has her own weapons and armor, so she should be fine for now… Alright, I’ll leave it to you.”
“As always, it looks like you’ve got enough money.”
“The profits from my peddling just flew away in the blink of an eye…”

My father is lamenting how much lighter his wallet has become. If it’s such a problem, maybe I should suggest raising the price of the medicine he sells a little? After all, my kind father sells it for slightly less than the market price.

Well, I suppose that’ll be resolved as research into improving the bio-plant progresses. After all, there’s a time limit on how long the Trash can hold onto power. It’s only another month and a half, so I think we’ll be fine as long as we can hold out until then.

Or rather… once the second wave passes, they’ll inevitably have to resort to forceful measures given the timing, and if I get put on the wanted list, I can just use the portal to retrieve the gear I’ve stashed in Siltvelt.
“Well… if this gets us to a decent place, I guess it’s a win…”
Father finished placing his equipment order, looking somewhat drained.
“An-chan, I’m glad you found such good companions.”
“You’re absolutely right…”
Father smiled and nodded at my father’s words. His smile was truly radiant.
“What should we do next?”
After we left the weapon shop, my Father asked me.
“Shall we head toward the Dragon Hourglass? It’ll tell us when the wave is coming to Melromarc.”
“Yeah, I guess so…”
“Though, in the first world, it seemed like we arrived a day before the wave, didn’t it?”
“Do we need to time it right?”
I recalled what happened in the first world.
“I happened to run into Ren and Itsuki again. And myself, of course.”

Back then, we’d come to do Class Up for the Crimson Swine. Itsuki and Ren were in a similar situation, too. Come to think of it, just like the rules of MMOs, leveling up when you’re weak takes a long time, but if strong players power-level, it doesn’t take nearly as long.
In fact, thanks to Yuki-chan and the others I trained, my Father and the others are already over Level 40. I was over 40 back then myself… but I’m sure I’m earning more now than I did then.

“Hmm… It’s not exactly an information exchange on the ‘Wave,’ but maybe meeting up to give progress reports or coordinate would be a good idea? After all, I’m sure Motoyasu-kun is curious about Ren and Itsuki’s situations, isn’t he?”

That’s true. Since I assassinated that Smoked Meat guy—who used to be part of Itsuki’s group—before he joined us, I do want to keep an eye on how things are changing. It’ll be a good opportunity to figure out whether Itsuki’s group is acting strangely because of that Smoked Meat guy, or if it’s because of Itsuki himself.

Above all, Crimson Swine should be traveling with Itsuki. It wouldn’t hurt to know what happens when Crimson Swine—who used to travel with me in the first world—acts alongside Itsuki. Let’s investigate that along with the effects of the Smoked Meat.

Besides, I’m a bit worried about Ren as well. Compared to the first world, Ren seems to harbor distrust toward Melromarc, and I have no idea what kind of differences that might cause. Of course, if there are no differences, that’s fine, and if there are, we’ll just have to deal with them. For the sake of gathering information, it seems best to go the day before the Wave.
“That’s right. Well then, let’s take it easy until the day before the Wave, doing some peddling and such.”
“It’d probably be a good idea to study a bit and learn to read and write while we’re at it, too.”
And with that, we climbed into the carriage and set off.
The day before the Wave. When we went to see the old man at the weapon shop, he raised his hand as if he’d been waiting for us.
“Hey! You’re finally here, An-chan and the gang.”
“How’s it going? Are the items I asked for ready?”
“Pretty much. And An-chan’s armor is finished, too.”

It seems the old man at the weapon shop has been making various modifications based on the equipment I gave him. My Father’s armor—which I recognize as barbarian armor—incorporates pieces of the armor I gave him in several places. Since the base is already there, custom-making it goes much faster.

Keel’s breastplate seems to be based on the armor I gave him in a similar way. You can see bits and pieces of that in the weapons, too. He’s done some simple modifications. Sakura and Keel are now wielding swords that look cheap but have exceptional sharpness.
“Thank you very much.”
“It’s no big deal—don’t worry about it. If possible… next time, I’d like to order something truly custom-made, just like An-chan’s armor.”
“Yes… I think the need will naturally arise. When that time comes, I’ll definitely be asking for something top-notch, so please take care of us.”
“Haha, I’ll definitely have to live up to An-chan’s expectations. I hear the waves are going to be rough tomorrow, so do your best.”
“I’ll do my best! The weapons I got are going to be on fire! Big bro!”
Keel steps forward and declares this before Father can even speak. Isn’t that just fine?
“Keel, please stop practicing your swings here—it’s dangerous.”
“I know.”
Sakura stares blankly at the blade of the sword she’s been handed.
“It cuts well… I guess?”
“You two, be careful. With dual-wielding, your focus can wander, and you might end up cutting yourselves.”
“Yeah, got it.”
“We’ll be fine, big bro!”
Sakura-chan and Keel cheerfully reply to their worried Father. However… Keel has been in dog form the whole time lately. Well, I guess it’s better than being a pig.
“Well then, let’s go, Motoyasu-kun.”
“Understood.”
“Come visit again, An-chan.”
“Of course, I’ll definitely come.”
And so, just as we’d planned, we headed toward the building housing the Dragon Hourglass.
